title.narrative: Irish Aid to UNHCR Lebanon for 2025

description.narrative: Voluntary flexible contribution to UNHCR Lebanon to support their strategic focus to preserve a dignified protection space for refugees and displaced persons in Lebanon. UNHCR’s programme will focus on preserving the protection space, ensuring dignified stay, enhancing social cohesion and enabling protection-driven solutions, including improving access to resettlement and/or complementary pathways to third countries and upholding the right to voluntary return in safety and dignity. This will include the provision to support protection needs including child protection and for gender-based violence responses, and support for basic needs including provision of core-relief items and for health, shelter, water, sanitation and hygiene-related activities. In 2025, over 700,000 refugees are registered for UNHCR, the majority of which are Syrians.
